_comment: Derived from the Wingsearch dataset (https://github.com/navarog/wingsearch), built on TawnyFrogmouth's Wingspan spreadsheet. Factual game data only.

entries.name: Mechanical Engineer
entries.condition: Sets of the 4 nest types
entries.description: Each star nest can be treated as any 1 nest type. No card can be part of more than one set.
entries.vp_text: 1 set = bowl-nest cavity-nest ground-nest platform-nest; one set: 3 VP; two sets: 8 VP

entries.description: Different columns may (but need not) score using different nest types. Star nests are wild, but each counts only once.
entries.vp_text: 2 of the same nest in a column: 1 VP; 3 of the same nest in a column: 3 VP
